# DocsForge

> An open-source documentation MCP server. Given the name of a library, framework or tool, DocsForge finds its official documentation through the package registries, verifies that the page really documents it, harvests the whole set as Markdown, and serves it to AI agents and coding assistants over the Model Context Protocol, with a coverage figure that says when a harvest is incomplete.

Built by Raj Patel (https://portfolio-raj-25.netlify.app/). MIT licensed. Install with `pipx install git+https://github.com/R204570/DocsForge` (the `docsforge` package on PyPI is an unrelated project). It runs on your own machine; there is no public hosted server.

Its 13 MCP tools: learn_technology, harvest_docs, harvest_status, find_docs, scan_project, fetch_docs, save_docs, detect_source_type, search_knowledge_base, read_knowledge_base, list_knowledge_base, forget_resolution, forget_selection.

## Site

- [Home](https://docsforge.vercel.app/): how a name is resolved, verified and harvested, a live find_docs resolver to try, coverage reporting, and a FAQ
- [Tools](https://docsforge.vercel.app/tools): every MCP tool, its arguments and what it returns
- [Setup](https://docsforge.vercel.app/setup): the step-by-step guide to running it on your own machine (Windows, macOS, Linux): install with pipx, check it runs, add it to a client, the first question, where the docs are kept, updating, optional extras, working from a clone, and troubleshooting
- [Connect](https://docsforge.vercel.app/connect): installing it, one command or config block per MCP client (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, VS Code, Claude Desktop) to run it on your own machine or reach a server you host, and storage
- [Contributors](https://docsforge.vercel.app/contributors): the maintainer, everyone who has contributed code, and how to become a contributor

## Source

- [README](https://github.com/R204570/DocsForge#readme): installation, the CLI, the MCP server, the web chat, and deployment
- [Contributing](https://github.com/R204570/DocsForge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to report a problem or propose a change
